_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Balkrishna Industries (BKT), consolidated, Rs crore. FY26 (Mar-2026) is the last reported year; Q1FY27 (Jun-2026, reported 29/30-Jul-2026) is the last quarter known on 30-Sep-2026. One reported segment; revenue comes from the business-line build below (OHT tyres, third-party carbon black, on-highway tyres), checked against model revenue in BALKRISIND.ctx.js. EBITDA is on Screener's basis (foreign-exchange gains and losses inside expenses).
_revenueWhy: From the business-line build (sum checked in BALKRISIND.ctx.js). FY27E +22.6%: OHT tyres +19% (volume +11% to ~352,000 MT: Q1 +16% on a tariff-hit base, H2 against record FY26 quarters; realisation +7%: ~5% price increase in Q1, EUR realised ~Rs102 in Q1 and FY27 hedges at ~Rs107 vs Rs94-99 in FY26, partly offset by India rising to ~40% of volume), third-party carbon black +38% (capacity 265,000 to 360,000 MTPA, ~10% of Q1 revenue), on-highway Rs200 cr (seeding year). Check: Q1FY27 revenue of Rs3,455 cr is 26% of our FY27E, the same share Q1 had in FY25. FY28E-29E: OHT +11% / +10% (volume +8%/+7% as the 35,000 MTPA expansion and debottlenecking take capacity towards 425,000 MTPA, price/mix +3%), carbon black +12% / +10%, on-highway Rs600 cr / Rs1,100 cr (Anand Rathi: Rs600 cr in FY28E; company target Rs5,000 cr by FY30, which we do not assume). Street FY27E/FY28E revenue: ICICI Direct Rs13,407 / 15,826 cr (31-Jul-2026); Geojit Rs12,771 / 14,942 cr (pre-Q1).

build._note: Business-line build (Rs crore). FY26 consolidated revenue Rs10,823 cr split with management's statement that third-party carbon black was ~9% of the business in FY26 (Q4FY26 call); on-highway revenue was negligible in FY26 (launched Feb-Apr 2026). On-highway is entered in rupees, not as growth.

_marginWhy: Screener basis (FX gains and losses in expenses): FY24 24.1%, FY25 23.5%, FY26 21.3%, Q1FY27 21.5%. FY27E 20.5%: management expects raw material +5% in Q2-Q3 (~3% of sales), a ~2pp margin hit next quarter, offset over time by the ~5% Q1 price increase; freight ~5% of revenue and could rise; India (lower margin) ~40% of volume; employee cost +18% in Q1; on-highway start-up losses. Helped by smaller FX losses: FY27 hedges at ~Rs107/EUR against Rs94-99 realised in FY26 (FY26 FX swing: -Rs517 cr, standalone). FY28E 21.5%, FY29E 22.0%: the raw-material spike eases and hedges roll at higher rates, but third-party carbon black (industry-average margins, management) and on-highway (mid-single-digit margins, Anand Rathi) grow to ~15% of revenue. Management's 23-25% company-wide target is not assumed (bull case). Street FY28E: ICICI Direct 20.4% (standalone basis), Geojit 22.6%, Anand Rathi 23.2%.
_capexWhy: Rs6,800 cr plan to FY29 (incl. Rs2,000 cr approved May-2026): ~Rs3,800 cr spent by Jun-26, Rs3,000 cr left; Q1FY27 ~Rs1,000 cr and Rs1,500-2,000 cr more in FY27 (Q1 call, 30-Jul-2026): FY27E Rs2,800 cr. FY28-29E: the remaining ~Rs1,000-1,500 cr plus ~Rs200 cr a year of maintenance (Q4FY26 call). Cash capex was Rs3,003 cr in FY26 and Rs1,483 cr in FY25 (Screener).
_depWhy: FY26 depreciation Rs775 cr = 6.5% of average gross block (Rs11,903 cr, Screener; Rs11,278 cr at Mar-25, Rs12,527 cr at Mar-26). Q1FY27 Rs206 cr, rising ~3-4% a quarter as carbon black phase 2 and the CV radial line are capitalised. The engine depreciates new capex at once and holds CWIP (Rs2,472 cr at Mar-26) flat, so we use 6.3%: ~Rs880 cr in FY27E.
_treasuryWhy: BKT has net debt (Rs922 cr at Mar-26 on Screener's consolidated basis: debt Rs4,111 cr vs investments Rs3,124 cr and cash Rs65 cr; Rs1,725 cr standalone at Jun-26), so the engine's yield on net treasury would be zero. All treasury income is built in otherIncome below and all interest in interest.
_otherIncomeWhy: Built from AR FY26 note 30. Treasury book at Mar-26: investments Rs3,124 cr + cash Rs65 cr, of which Rs637 cr is strategic equity (NSE stake Rs593 cr, start-ups) that earns only dividends; the interest-bearing and mark-to-market part (debt funds, Bharat Bond ETFs, AIFs, bonds) was ~Rs2,550 cr and earned Rs217 cr in FY26 (interest Rs47 cr, distributions Rs39 cr, realised and MTM gains Rs131 cr) = ~8.1% of the average book, flattered by falling rates. We use 7% on a book run down to ~Rs2,300 cr to fund capex (FY27E) and rebuilt to ~Rs2,600 cr (FY29E), plus dividends ~Rs18 cr (FY26 Rs17 cr) and other income ~Rs16 cr. FY27E Rs235 cr = Q1 actual Rs100 cr (incl. FX and MTM items) + ~Rs45 cr a quarter. FY26 Rs252 cr, TTM to Jun-26 Rs244 cr; FY25 Rs539 cr included a Rs267 cr FX gain that does not recur in our model.
_interestLabel: Interest cost (packing credit and other working-capital loans, NCDs, term loans)
_interestWhy: FY26 Rs134 cr on average debt of ~Rs3,690 cr (3.6%: mostly low-cost foreign-currency export credit; NCDs at 7.20-7.55%); Q1FY27 Rs37 cr. Debt rose to Rs4,690 cr (standalone) at Jun-26 and we expect ~Rs5,200 cr at Mar-27 as FY27 capex (Rs2,800 cr) exceeds operating cash; ~3.8% on ~Rs4,650 cr average = Rs175 cr. FY28E Rs185 cr (NCDs a larger share), FY29E Rs165 cr as free cash flow repays debt.
_payoutWhy: Rs16 a share in FY25 and FY26 (Rs4 a quarter) = 25% of FY26 EPS, 19% of FY25; first interim of Rs4 for FY27. 22% of our EPS is ~Rs16-21 a share.

dcf._betaWhy: Export-led (~64% of revenue), farm-cycle and currency-exposed, now with modest net debt (~2-4% of market value): beta 1.0, Ke 12.5%. Debt is small, so the cost of equity is the discount rate.
dcf._tgWhy: Global OHT volumes grow ~3% a year (Smithers via AR FY26: 52.5 mn to 57 mn units, 2026-29) and India OHT ~5.5%; BKT adds share gains and price. 5.5% nominal terminal growth (house range 5-6%).
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~13% to 8% over 12 years: share gains in a ~3% market, India and on-highway growth.
dcf._fadeMarginWhy: EBITDA margin held at 22%: below the FY16-25 OHT-only history (mostly 24-26%) because carbon black and on-highway tyres earn less.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Capital-hungry: capex fades to 7% of revenue (FY17-26 cash capex averaged ~16.5% of revenue in a build-out decade; 5-12% in the lighter years FY17, FY18 and FY24); depreciation 6% of revenue (FY26 7.2%).

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Europe and the US recover together (US duty stays ~10%, tariff refunds received), price increases stick as raw materials ease, the EUR stays near ₹107-110, and management's 23-25% margin target is met by FY29E even as on-highway scales.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: A hot, dry European season and weak farm incomes stall agricultural demand; crude-linked raw materials and freight keep rising with the Middle East conflict; the rupee strengthens against the hedge book; on-highway losses run longer, so the margin stays near 18-19%.

methods.name: P/E
methods.why: How the street values BKT: P/E on one-year-forward EPS (MOSL 22x, ICICI Direct 27x, Anand Rathi 28x, Geojit 26x, all FY28E). Multiple derived in BALKRISIND.ctx.js and written by BALKRISIND.val.js.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: Values the operating business; net debt at the target date is deducted.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: Tests whether cash flows support the price: 12-year FCFF, Ke 12.5%, terminal growth 5.5%, less net debt.
